reviews.text: This company is always professional, prompt, and has clean communication so you know what to expect and they follow through.  I work with them for my routine service and any repairs needed.  I had a mechanical issue that they were able to diagnose and repair the same day along with multiple options for cost vs. impact decision.  Jackson was excellent to work with.  Thanks!
reviews.author: Shawn Kerns

reviews.text: I have been using Clear Choice for 7 year now and they are fantastic. Justice always does a great job for any repairs or service that I need. Recommend them highly!
reviews.author: Hal Stewart

reviews.text: As always, this company is quick to respond. Service tech Justice came out immediately and got my equipment app up and running. I highly recommend using them for pool service.
reviews.author: Jim Otto

reviews.text: Clear Choice Pools has been great to us. From weekly maintenance to service calls, they've always sent someone who knows their stuff! The staff is kind and professional and gets you taken care of in a timely manner. The guys are always willing to answer questions about your pool, including how something works, anytime they are asked. For the weekly maintenance, I LOVE the email telling me exactly what was addressed, along with a photo of the pool after the cleaning.
reviews.author: Craig Allen

reviews.text: Clear Choice has handled by weekly service since I moved 11 years ago.  The techs are always friendly and kind to both wife, children, and animals.  I get detailed reports of issues and a plan of action with an estimate to fix.  I appreciate that communication is only as needed and meaningful when I receive a notice from Clear Choice.  By far the best service provider and only remaining service provider we have used since day 1.
reviews.author: Annie Martin

reviews.text: We had an excellent experience using Clear Choice Pool Care. The technicians were knowledgeable and provided great quality work as well as timely. Customer service minded and very patient addressing our questions and concerns. We feel we have found the perfect solution to our pool for many years to come!
reviews.author: Sokol Gorenca

reviews.text: Clear  Choice Pool Care is a fantastic weekly pool service provider ! Even on the one occasion when my pool started to turn greenish, they sent out a Tech who provided a service that morning and much to our surprise, it was beautiful blue that evening. Honestly !! They also let you know if they observe any potential issues with the equipment! Best  choice !
reviews.author: Roger Powers

reviews.text:
Clearly Choice Pool performs ours weekly pool services on two homes.  Have never had an issues with their service.  Our pools have never looked better.  They are very professional and accommodating.

We recently had a small fire due to the pool heater.  Clearly Choice worked with our insurance provider to have the equipment replaced.  They did an excellent job and the communication was top notch.
reviews.author: Danny Trager
